title: a unit the registry does not know inside a constraint body
note: FIXED 2026-09-03. `unknown-unit` read only `attrs.unit`, so `{ uav.mtow <= 25.0 [furlong] }` parsed, evaluated to unknown and reported nothing but a misleading "Unexpected character '['" — the bracket is the intended syntax. KerML's textual grammar (note 2 on BracketExpression) asks a tool to warn when `[` is used with no concrete definition; the rule now scans constraint bodies, transition guards and expression values, and the constraint's info names the unit instead of the bracket. The scan reads the token stream, so a bracket inside a STRING value or a string literal in a body (`"R-UAV-001 [rev A]"`) is text, not a unit — the fixture carries one to pin it.
